unavailable.reason: Restricted raw generated result scratch path is absent. Retained old score covers only historical marked edges and cannot recover all eight current word edges. No arbitrary inference or transcript reconstruction performed.

limits: Prepared mono16k WAV scratch file is absent; its recorded hash agrees across frozen records but cannot be freshly rehashed. Model/runtime identities are recorded historical fingerprints, not a rerun or current-environment certification.

Eight-edge numerical pass does not replace full corpus inventory, protected-word coverage, repetition-removal intent, independent join auditions, memory evaluation or independent held-out confirmation.
Opening um onset is clip-censored and not scored; its end is reported separately. Sentence endpoints are not individual word edges.
No candidate is rewritten, selected or promoted; historical scores and labels remain unchanged.
